data.name: RemoteNote
data.value: This was recorded in a Remote Desktop session: Windows sends pictures only as often as the connection allows, and the graphics card's encoder may not be available.

data.name: RecordingUnavailable
data.value: Screen recording isn't available. {0}
data.comment: {0} is the reason (a sentence)

data.name: NoVideoEncoderDetail
data.value: No video encoder works on this PC: {0}
data.comment: {0} lists each encoder with its problem

data.name: NoVideoEncoder
data.value: No video encoder works on this PC.

data.name: NoEncoderCouldRecord
data.value: No video encoder could record {0}x{1}. {2}
data.comment: {0}x{1} is a size in pixels, {2} each encoder's problem

data.name: NoEncoderCouldEncode
data.value: No video encoder could encode {0}x{1}. {2}
data.comment: {0}x{1} is a size in pixels, {2} each encoder's problem

data.name: WebcamsUnavailable
data.value: Webcams aren't available in this copy of the app.

data.name: WebcamSentNoPicture
data.value: {0} sent no picture ({1}), so the recording has no webcam.
data.comment: {0} is the webcam's name, {1} the reason (English, from Windows)

data.name: WebcamTrackStopped
data.value: The webcam's own track stopped ({0}); the webcam is still drawn over the recording.
data.comment: {0} is the reason

data.name: AllSystemAudioInstead
data.value: {0} All system audio is recorded instead.
data.comment: {0} is why one app's sound can't be left out (a sentence)

data.name: VideoHasNoSound
data.value: {0} The video has no sound.
data.comment: {0} says why the sound devices can't be used (sentences)

data.name: SoundNoteAt
data.comment: {0} is a time in the recording (1:05), {1} what happened to a sound device

data.name: VideoEncoderHung
data.value: The video encoder stopped responding.

data.name: EncoderHung
data.value: {0} stopped responding.
data.comment: {0} is an encoder's name

data.name: NoFramesRecorded
data.value: no frames were recorded
data.comment: the reason in NotSaved

data.name: NotSaved
data.value: The recording could not be saved ({0}).
data.comment: {0} is the reason

data.name: NotSavedKept
data.value: The recording could not be saved ({0}). It was kept and can be recovered from the tray menu.
data.comment: {0} is the reason

data.name: NotSavedUnreadable
data.value: The recording could not be saved: nothing in it could be read.

data.name: StoppedEarly
data.value: Recording stopped early: {0}
data.comment: {0} is the reason

data.name: ThenSeparator
data.value: , then
data.comment: between the names of the encoders a recording used, in order

data.name: InputNotFollowed
data.value: Clicks and keys couldn't be followed ({0}).
data.comment: {0} is the reason

data.name: DeviceLostNote
data.value: At {0} the graphics card was reset or switched; the picture held still until it was back.
data.comment: {0} is a time in the recording (1:05)

data.name: DeviceLostWarning
data.value: The graphics card stopped responding (it was reset or switched). The recording goes on, and the picture holds still until it is back.

data.name: DeviceBack
data.value: The graphics card is back after {0:0.#} s; the recording carries on.
data.comment: {0} is in seconds

data.name: DeviceGaveUp
data.value: The graphics card stopped working and wasn't back within {0:0} s, so the recording stopped.
data.comment: {0} is in seconds

data.name: ResolutionChangedNote
data.value: At {0} {1} changed resolution, so from there the recording is {2}x{3}, saved as another file.
data.comment: {0} is a time in the recording (1:05), {1} a monitor (DISPLAY2), {2}x{3} the new size in pixels

data.name: ResolutionChangedWarning
data.value: {0} changed resolution. The recording goes on at {1}x{2} and is saved as another file.
data.comment: {0} is a monitor (DISPLAY2), {1}x{2} the new size in pixels

data.name: EncoderSwitchedNote
data.value: {0} stopped working at {1}; {2} recorded the rest, saved as another file.
data.comment: {0} and {2} are encoders' names, {1} a time in the recording (1:05)

data.name: EncoderSwitchedWarning
data.value: {0} stopped working ({1}). Recording continues with {2}; it will be saved as another file.
data.comment: {0} and {2} are encoders' names, {1} the reason

data.name: EncoderFailedNoFallback
data.value: The video encoder stopped working and no other could take over ({0}).
data.comment: {0} is the reason

data.name: SecureScreenNote
data.value: From {0} to {1} Windows showed a secure screen (a UAC prompt or the lock screen), which no app can capture: the video holds the last picture there.
data.comment: {0} and {1} are times in the recording (1:05)

data.name: MonitorDisconnected
data.value: {0} was disconnected, so the recording stopped.
data.comment: {0} is a monitor (DISPLAY2)

data.name: SleepNote
data.value: At {0} the PC went to sleep, so the recording was paused.
data.comment: {0} is a time in the recording (1:05)

data.name: WokeUp
data.value: The PC woke up. The recording was paused at {0} when it went to sleep: resume or stop it from the toolbar.
data.comment: {0} is a time in the recording (1:05)

data.name: ProbeTimedOut
data.value: It didn't answer within {0:0} s.
data.comment: why an encoder doesn't work; {0} is in seconds

data.comment: {0} is the reason (a sentence)

data.comment: {0} is a video's file name, {1} the metadata file's name

data.name: OverlaysAlreadyDrawn

data.comment: {0} is a video's file name

data.name: OverlaysFailed
data.value: Overlays couldn't be added to {0}: {1}
data.comment: {0} is a video's file name, {1} the reason

data.name: NoPictureFromWindows
data.value: Windows sent no picture of {0} within {1:0} s.
data.comment: {0} is a monitor (DISPLAY2), {1} seconds

data.name: CaptureStopped
data.value: Screen capture stopped: {0}
data.comment: {0} is the reason
